persona_nf_detail:
A warm and empathetic counselor.

Reads your heart first and delivers fortune readings with warm emotion. Recommended when you need comfort and empathy.
persona_nt_detail:
A logical and systematic analyst.

Provides evidence-based readings by precisely analyzing five elements, ten gods, and compatibility. Recommended for in-depth fortune analysis.
persona_sf_detail:
A friendly and cheerful counselor, like a close friend.

Explains fortune easily and enjoyably in a comfortable conversation. Recommended for casual fortune readings.
persona_st_detail:
A counselor who gives direct and realistic advice.

Gets straight to the point without sugar-coating, interpreting fortune from a practical perspective. Recommended when you want clear answers.
persona_babyMonk_detail:
A little master, Baby Monk. Reads fortune boldly in casual speech with truth-bombs that hit the mark.

Recommended for honest fortune readings in a light atmosphere.
persona_scenarioWriter_detail: A storyteller who weaves fortune into a narrative.
persona_yinYangGrandpa_detail:
Yin-Yang Grandpa finds light in darkness and shadows in light — a master of dramatic twists.

Acknowledges hard facts head-on, then dramatically reveals hidden strengths to offer hope. Recommended when you need comfort and surprising twists.
persona_sewerSaju_detail:
Sewer Sorcerer is a brutal truth master who fearlessly exposes the dark side of your fortune.

Makes you face reality with sharp wit and refreshing honesty. Warning: not for the faint-hearted!
